name: Resourceinn
description_en:
Resourceinn is a modular cloud HRMS covering people records, attendance, payroll, recruitment, performance and training. Its People module connects profiles, documents, organization structure, letters and lifecycle checklists, while the commercial plan is built from selected modules and add-ons.

The official pages advertise both a free plan for up to 10 users and paid headcount-based proposals, but contain inconsistent trial and setup wording. This draft preserves those discrepancies rather than converting them into a confirmed universal free entitlement or implementation promise.
description_zh:
Resourceinn 是模块化云端 HRMS，涵盖人员档案、考勤、工资、招聘、绩效及培训。People 模块连接档案、文档、组织结构、信函和生命周期清单，商务方案则按所选模块及附加项组合。

官方页面既宣传最多 10 用户免费套餐，也提供按人数定制的收费方案，但试用和设置费表述不一致。本稿保留这些差异，不把它们改写成已确认的普遍免费权益或实施承诺。

core_features.explanation_en: Maintain employee profiles, custom fields, salary changes, organizational hierarchy and role-based access.
core_features.explanation_zh: 维护员工档案、自定义字段、薪资变动、组织层级及角色权限。

core_features.name_zh: 文档、信函与生命周期清单
core_features.explanation_en: The People module describes stored documents, expiry reminders, letters and onboarding/offboarding tasks assigned to relevant teams.
core_features.explanation_zh: People 模块描述文档存储、到期提醒、信函及向相关团队分配的入离职任务。

core_features.explanation_en: Choose People, Attendance, Payroll, Recruitment, Performance and Training, with separate add-ons such as kiosk, BI and integrations.
core_features.explanation_zh: 可选人员、考勤、工资、招聘、绩效和培训，另有终端、BI 及集成等附加项。

pricing.summary_en: People page advertises free forever up to 10 users; paid pricing by active employees/modules requires quote. Trial and setup statements conflict and need written clarification.
pricing.summary_zh: People 页宣传最多 10 用户永久免费，收费按活跃员工及模块询价。试用期限和设置费用说法冲突，需书面澄清。

sources.title: Best People Management Software for Core HR | Resourceinn
sources.research_notes_en: Read records, checklists, documents, role controls, native integration examples and advertised free-forever offer up to 10 users.

sources.title: HR Software Pricing | Get Resourceinn HRMS Pricing Plans
sources.research_notes_en: Read modular quote builder, add-ons, support hours and conflicting three-/fourteen-day trial and setup-fee wording.

official_check.scope: Public primary sources read; no account, purchase, integration execution, performance benchmark, owner identity or publication approval tested.

review_notes: Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation from the attached primary sources. Vendor documentation does not establish independent testing or customer outcomes.
Original directory feature labels were replaced with product-specific documented capabilities. Unknowns and unreviewed alternatives remain unknown.

sections.title_en: Start with a record and an accountable checklist
sections.title_zh: 从档案和责任清单开始
sections.en: The People module is described as the central library for employee details, roles, documents, job history, assets and organization hierarchy. Onboarding can assign tasks to HR, IT and managers; offboarding can coordinate clearance, asset retrieval and final settlement. For an illustrative exit, verify the employee’s entity, assigned laptop, document access and each checklist owner, then inspect the settlement handoff. The source describes coordination but does not establish automatic completion of every external access-removal action. Permission, audit-log and backup claims remain vendor statements rather than inspected controls.
sections.zh: People 模块被描述为员工资料、角色、文档、任职历史、资产和组织层级的中央库。入职可向 HR、IT 和经理分派任务，离职可协调交接、资产收回及最终结算。离职示例可以核对实体、笔记本、文档权限和清单负责人，再检查结算衔接。来源描述的是协调，不代表所有外部权限移除动作均自动完成。权限、审计日志和备份仍属于供应商声明，未经控制检查。

sections.title_en: Quote the modules and the connectors separately
sections.title_zh: 分别确认模块与连接器
sections.en: The pricing builder lets buyers select People, Attendance, Payroll, Recruitment, Performance and Training. Additional sections cover piece-rate payroll, BI analytics, kiosk and integrations. The People FAQ names Xero and QuickBooks as built-in examples and says other integrations can be requested; the pricing page lists a much broader integration catalog. Do not interpret every listed name as an already demonstrated bidirectional connector. Define fields, direction, approvals and retries. A payroll evaluation also needs explicit country and employer scope; a generic global-compliance phrase does not prove each filing is supported.
sections.zh: 价格构建器可选人员、考勤、工资、招聘、绩效及培训，附加部分另列计件工资、BI、终端及集成。People FAQ 将 Xero 和 QuickBooks 列为内建示例，并称其他集成可申请；价格页则展示更广集成目录。不能把每个名称都理解为已演示的双向连接器，需明确字段、方向、审批和重试。工资评估还需具体国家及雇主范围，泛称全球合规不能证明每种申报都支持。

sections.title_en: Resolve free-plan, trial and setup differences
sections.title_zh: 核对免费、试用和设置差异
sections.en: The People page advertises a free-forever full HR suite for teams of 10 or fewer users, while the current pricing builder quotes active employees and selected modules without numeric paid rates. Clarify whether “users” and employees are counted the same way and which modules and support the free offer includes. Pricing banners advertise a three-day trial, but the same page’s FAQ says fourteen days. The People page says free setup; the pricing FAQ includes a one-time implementation fee in the price description. These cannot be collapsed into one confirmed term. The FAQ advertises a 30-day refund and cancellation at any time; obtain applicable written terms before payment.
sections.zh: People 页宣传 10 用户及以下可永久免费使用完整 HR 套件，当前价格构建器则按活跃员工和所选模块询价，没有收费金额。需澄清用户与员工是否同一计数、免费方案包含哪些模块及支持。价格横幅写三天试用，同页 FAQ 却写十四天；People 页写免费设置，价格 FAQ 则在费用描述中列入一次性实施费。这些不能归并成一个已确认条款。FAQ 宣传 30 天退款及随时取消，付款前仍需取得适用书面条款。

sections.title_en: Test the correction path and support coverage
sections.title_zh: 测试纠错路径及支持覆盖
sections.en: The pricing FAQ states ordinary support is Monday–Saturday, 9 AM–8 PM Pakistan time, while other sections advertise optional premium coverage. That is not unconditional round-the-clock support for every subscription. Resourceinn may suit buyers wanting several HR processes around one record; a small team should first resolve the free-plan boundaries. Prepare employee identities, opening balances, policies and task owners, then test one rejected request, amended document and failed synchronization before retiring spreadsheets. Numeric pricing, the contradictory trial/setup terms, hosting jurisdiction, export completeness, recovery, certification scope and source-code license remain unverified; no live tenant was tested.
sections.zh: 价格 FAQ 说明常规支持为巴基斯坦时间周一至周六 9:00–20:00，其他章节宣传可选高级覆盖，不能理解为每份订阅无条件全天候支持。需要围绕一份档案组合多项 HR 流程的买家可评估 Resourceinn，小团队先澄清免费边界。应准备员工身份、期初余额、政策和任务负责人，在停用表格前测试拒批、文档修改及同步失败。数值价格、矛盾的试用和设置条款、托管辖区、完整导出、恢复、认证范围及源代码许可仍未核实，未测试实际租户。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Hypothetical examples are not executed tests.

research_gaps.en: Free-plan entitlements/counting, trial duration and setup charge are unresolved across official statements.
research_gaps.zh: 官方说法中的免费权益及计数、试用期限和设置费仍未解决。

research_gaps.en: No tenant, document, payroll, export or connector workflow was executed.
research_gaps.zh: 未实际执行租户、文档、工资、导出或连接器流程。
